press-black.$description: Press Black — Primary text, nav borders, button fills, card backgrounds, footer — the single dominant ink color driving the entire system's contrast logic

charcoal-ink.$description: Charcoal Ink — Body copy, secondary headings, list items — one step off pure black for long-form text

blank-canvas.$description: Blank Canvas — Card backgrounds, button fills (secondary), icon fills — the pure white counterpart to Press Black

fog-sheet.$description: Fog Sheet — Page section backgrounds, hero overlay text, badge fills — the off-white that softens full-white sections

ash-border.$description: Ash Border — Nav dividers, separator lines

slate-text.$description: Slate Text — Muted link text, de-emphasized body labels

steel-gray.$description: Steel Gray — Body text, icon strokes, link defaults — mid-gray for supporting content hierarchy

deep-void.$description: Deep Void — Near-black nav text, alternate heading color

pixel-blush.$description: Pixel Blush — Token-defined accent — appears as CSS variable; reserved for product-feature highlights and gradient transitions

neon-loop.$description: Neon Loop — Token-defined vivid accent — CSS variable; reserved for on-brand product UI illustrations and feature callouts

codeberry.$description: Codeberry — Token-defined dark magenta — CSS variable; reserved for deep accent backgrounds in product feature sections

roobert.$description: The site's entire typographic identity. Weight 900 at 56–88px drives hero headlines — the extreme weight creates impact that substitutes for color. Negative letter-spacing (-0.02em at display, -0.01em at subheading) compresses letterforms into a dense, printed-matter feel. 'ss14' feature setting activates alternate letterforms. Used for headings, nav, buttons, badges, body at every weight.

times.$description: System serif fallback — appears in nav, body, and footer contexts. Likely a browser fallback for edge cases rather than an intentional brand serif. Not a signature choice.
